name: item
title: Item
description: A row of content: a glyph or picture, a title over a muted line, actions at the end.
usage: Use for rows in a list or a settings group: an API key with its last use, a monitor with its schedule, a team member with their role. ItemGroup stacks them; ItemSeparator rules them. As a link or button (asChild) an item washes on hover; aria-current marks the selected one. `outline` puts a row on its own card, `muted` on the subtle gray; size sm makes sidebar-height rows.
avoid: Two lines of actions in one row
A row that moves on hover
